newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank says Q1 M2 money up "around 13 pct".
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank says Q1 M2 money up "around 13 pct".

text.p: The Slovak cental bank on Tuesday said the country's key money supply measure, M2, rose "around 13 percent" year-on-year in the first quarter of this year, compared with a 20 percent increase last year.

"This year's development of monetary criteria has so far been in line with the 1997 monetary programme, with the M2 aggregate rising by around 13 percent year-on-year in the January-March period, down from 20 percent in the same period last year," NBS statement said.
